title: Convert approved Markdown documents to PDF

requirement.userGoal: Render local Markdown through an approved template and produce a deterministic PDF artifact.

existingCapabilities.name: Pandoc
existingCapabilities.gap: The approved template, input checks, and output naming convention must be applied consistently.

advantages: Wraps a mature CLI with deterministic validation and repository defaults.
limitations: Remains specific to the local build environment.

advantages: Could explain when and how to invoke the script.
limitations: Does not replace the deterministic conversion command.

advantages: Could expose conversion as a discoverable tool.
limitations: Adds service operation with no live external state, central policy, or cross-host need.

correctnessBoundaries.rule: Only files inside the configured source directory may be converted.
correctnessBoundaries.failureBehaviour: Reject paths outside the repository boundary.

decision.rationale: The work is a narrow deterministic transformation using an existing CLI. A local wrapper supplies the missing validation and defaults.

rejectedAlternatives.reason: A skill may document the workflow later, but the conversion itself belongs in deterministic code.
A server boundary provides no material capability or governance benefit.
